description: Golden conformance vectors covering cast, scale (IEEE-754 single-op bit patterns), unit (all time and byte units), parse_time (all 10 formats including exact decimal unix_s), lower (locale-independent UTF-8), and enum_map transforms.

vectors.description: cast to string converts int hole lexeme to string
cast to string converts boolean object value to 'false'
cast to int parses signed integer from word hole
cast to int accepts leading + sign
cast to int converts boolean false to 0
cast to int fails with cast_failed on alphabetic word
cast to int fails with int_overflow on INT64_MAX+1
cast to float parses scientific notation from word hole
cast to float fails with cast_failed on non-numeric string
cast to float rejects NaN with cast_failed
cast to bool accepts uppercase TRUE
cast to bool accepts lowercase false
cast to bool converts integer 1 to true
cast to bool converts integer 0 to false
cast to bool rejects integer 2 with cast_failed
cast to bool rejects 'maybe' with cast_failed
cast to json parses JSON array from rest hole (SQL-supported, no json hole)
cast to json returns invalid_json parse_error on malformed JSON string
IEEE-754 pin: 57 / 100 = 0.57 (3fe23d70a3d70a3d, differs from 57 * 0.01)
scale div handles negative input -1999 / 100 = -19.99
scale div handles negative integer divisor 1999 / -100
scale div on zero yields +0.0
scale mul multiplies integer 1999 by 100
scale mul converts float ratio 0.75 * 100 = 75.0
scale mul by -1 negates value
scale div producing exact integer populates int field
chained scale mul:3 then div:2 evaluates left-to-right in double arithmetic
scale mul overflowing finite float64 reports float_overflow parse_error
scale on non-numeric object value produces type_mismatch parse_error

parse_time with omitted format defaults to auto and parses ISO 8601 UTC
parse_time format:auto parses Apache timestamp
parse_time format:iso8601 preserves millisecond precision
parse_time format:iso8601 truncates sub-millisecond nanoseconds to ms
parse_time format:iso8601 adjusts -05:00 offset to UTC epoch ms
parse_time format:rfc3339 adjusts +05:30 offset with fractional seconds
parse_time format:rfc2822 parses email/HTTP date with +0000
parse_time format:rfc2822 adjusts -0500 offset to UTC
parse_time format:syslog parses RFC 5424 ISO timestamp
parse_time format:syslog resolves yearless RFC 3164 using UTC year of reference_ts_ms
parse_time format:apache adjusts -0500 offset to UTC
parse_time format:unix_s converts integer epoch seconds to ms
parse_time format:unix_s converts fractional epoch seconds to ms
parse_time format:unix_ms preserves epoch milliseconds
parse_time format:unix_us truncates epoch microseconds to ms
parse_time format:unix_ns truncates epoch nanoseconds to ms
parse_time rejects impossible date 2026-02-30 with invalid_time parse_error
parse_time format:iso8601 rejects Apache formatted string with invalid_time
parse_time format:unix_s parses '1.001' via exact decimal arithmetic to 1001 ms (not binary64 1000)
parse_time format:unix_s truncates negative sub-millisecond fraction '-1.0019' toward zero to -1001 ms
parse_time format:iso8601 rejects offset-less timestamp without Z or numeric offset
parse_time format:iso8601 adjusts compact -0500 offset to UTC epoch ms
float hole feeding direct parse_time(unix_s) preserves original decimal lexeme 1795701600.12399999 without binary64 rounding

lower converts ASCII uppercase letters to lowercase
lower leaves digits, punctuation, and lowercase ASCII unchanged
lower handles empty string
lower folds Unicode UTF-8 uppercase characters (CAFÉ -> café)
enum_map maps exact matching raw value to canonical enum label
enum_map is case-sensitive and falls back to default when unmapped
enum_map without default reports unmapped_enum parse_error on unknown key
chained lower + enum_map normalizes case before lookup
chained lower + enum_map falls back to default on unknown value
chained cast(string) + enum_map maps integer arg to enum
chained cast(string) + enum_map uses default for unmapped status code
lower on integer object value produces type_mismatch parse_error
lower performs locale-independent root Unicode folding (İ -> i+U+0307, ASCII I -> i)
int hole enforces Int64 range before scale transform and rejects 2^63 with int_overflow
float hole with integral value 12.0 converts cleanly to int field
float hole with fractional value 12.5 fails conversion to int field with type_mismatch
